# 10x

> 10x is a curated marketplace of Claude Code plugins that ship quality, not bloat. It is a hub repository, not a tool: you add it once and install any of its seven plugins. Every plugin ships as skills (Markdown files an agent reads), so all seven also install into 70+ other agents through `npx skills add`; the three tool plugins (sniff, ui-ux-suite, recap-studio) additionally run as a standalone MCP server. Nothing here has telemetry, everything runs locally, and every plugin must pass an explicit eight-point quality bar to be listed. Dependencies are kept to what the job needs: ui-ux-suite and recap-studio ship zero runtime dependencies, the four skill plugins are pure Markdown, and sniff carries 16 (including Playwright and Lighthouse) because it drives a real browser. MIT licensed (each plugin keeps its own license). Last verified 2026-09-02.

The marketplace manifest is `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. Plugins install from their own GitHub repos via the `github` source, so installation works whether or not a package is published to npm. The quality bar lives in `QUALITY-BAR.md` and is re-verified on a quarterly review.

## The seven plugins

- **sniff** (0.8.0, Apache-2.0): Point it at your running app and it walks your real user flows in a real browser, then reports what is broken with proof: the route, the ordered steps, and the screenshot or console excerpt behind each finding. A source scan is also available via `sniff scan`. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/sniff
- **ui-ux-suite** (0.6.0, MIT): ESLint for design. Reads your CSS, JSX, HTML and Tailwind classes and names the file, the line, the measured wrong value and the exact fix, with the WCAG criterion or named UX law behind it. Scores 12 dimensions. It audits, it never edits. Zero runtime dependencies. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/ui-ux-suite
- **recap-studio** (0.5.0, MIT): Turns any topic or coding session into a dark-mode, mobile-first explainer you can double-click to open. The output is one HTML file with every style inlined, no JavaScript and no external request, readable offline in about five minutes. Deterministic heuristic checks score it before you ship. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/recap-studio
- **aws-cost-audit** (0.3.0, MIT): A Claude Code skill that reads your live AWS account read-only through the AWS CLI, attributes every dollar, finds idle, orphaned and over-provisioned resources, and ships a safe, reversible, gated savings plan with confidence levels. No price is quoted from memory; every figure comes from live AWS pricing and CI fails the build if a price is hardcoded. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill
- **goalify** (2.6.0, MIT): A Claude Code skill that scopes a big coding task, locks the few real decisions, and writes the brief (a file the run works from) plus the condition (one line you paste into /goal), so a fresh full-context session executes the whole job, quotes the passing checks in its closing turn, and archives the brief to .goal/done/. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/goalify
- **humanizer** (0.7.0, MIT): A Claude Code skill that names 55 AI writing patterns (inflated symbolism, em dash overuse, promotional language, rule-of-three, and more), scores text on a 0-100 AI-tell scale, and rewrites it with sentence-length burstiness across 5 voice profiles (casual, professional, technical, warm, blunt). Pure Markdown, zero dependencies, no network calls. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/humanizer-skill
- **loopify** (1.1.0, MIT): A Claude Code skill for a job that repeats (babysitting a release PR, watching a deploy, sweeping new bug reports). It writes the brief (a standing file the loop re-reads at the start of every tick) plus the line (one short string you paste into Claude Code's built-in /loop), with a tick cap, a stop rule, and five safety rails. Every tick logs what it did to TICKS.md; what it cannot do safely waits in QUEUE.md. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/loopify

## Install

- Add the marketplace once: `claude plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/10x`
- Install a plugin: `claude plugin install <name>@10x` (e.g. `claude plugin install sniff@10x`, `ui-ux-suite@10x`, `recap-studio@10x`, `aws-cost-audit@10x`, `goalify@10x`, `humanizer@10x`, `loopify@10x`).
- Outside Claude Code, install any of the seven with the Vercel skills CLI: `npx skills add Aboudjem/<repo>`, optionally with `-a <agent>` (for example `-a cursor`, `-a codex`, `-a github-copilot`, `-a gemini-cli`). The repo names are `sniff`, `ui-ux-suite`, `recap-studio`, `aws-cost-audit-skill`, `goalify`, `humanizer-skill`, `loopify`.
- The three tool plugins are dual-mode and also run as a standalone MCP server (`npx sniff-qa --mcp`, `npx ui-ux-suite --mcp`; recap-studio's server runs from a clone after `pnpm install && pnpm -w build`). Per-editor snippets for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Continue, OpenCode and Zed live in each repo's `docs/editors.md`. `aws-cost-audit`, `goalify`, `humanizer` and `loopify` are Claude Code skills rather than MCP servers.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/README.md): What 10x is, the seven plugins, the one-command install, and the quality bar.
- [QUALITY-BAR.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/QUALITY-BAR.md): The explicit eight-point, 29-item checklist every listed plugin must pass.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to propose a plugin for the marketplace.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI agents using this marketplace.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Dated history of marketplace changes.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a problem with the marketplace, and where plugin-specific reports go.
- [docs/SYNC.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/docs/SYNC.md): How the version pins stay in sync with the plugin repos.
- [Marketplace manifest](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): The machine-readable plugin list consumed by `claude plugin marketplace add`.

## Plugin repos

- [sniff](https://github.com/Aboudjem/sniff): Walks your running app in a real browser and finds real bugs, with steps to reproduce.
- [ui-ux-suite](https://github.com/Aboudjem/ui-ux-suite): Design audit across 12 dimensions; every finding names a line, a value and a fix.
- [recap-studio](https://github.com/Aboudjem/recap-studio): Self-contained offline one-page explainers.
- [aws-cost-audit-skill](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill): Evidence-first, read-only AWS cost audit with prices checked live.
- [goalify](https://github.com/Aboudjem/goalify): Writes the brief and the condition a fresh session runs, verifies, and files in .goal/done/.
- [humanizer-skill](https://github.com/Aboudjem/humanizer-skill): Names 55 AI writing patterns, scores text 0-100, and rewrites with burstiness and 5 voice profiles.
- [loopify](https://github.com/Aboudjem/loopify): Writes the brief and the line that keep a recurring job running on `/loop`, logging every tick.
